title: MORI
description:
MORI is a fictional scented candle brand exploring bold, minimalist packaging and a distinctive visual identity.

A dark foundation, expressive typography, and vibrant colors give each scent its own personality while keeping the collection visually cohesive.

Morning, Golden Hour, and Midnight each have a unique color and mood, creating a recognizable collection with strong shelf presence.

title: Kistefos museum
description:
A fictional personal project exploring visual identity for the museum kistefos through motion and graphic design.

I brought three sculptures from Yayoi Kusama, Dana Schutz and Cory Arcangel to life through animation, giving the works a new visual dimension. The project extends across posters, postcards and a tote bag, creating a fictional campaign and identity application for the museum.

title: AURELIS CAPITAL
description:
AURELIS CAPITAL is a fictional investment company built around strength, confidence, and long-term vision.

Inspired by the mythical griffin, the logo combines the power of a lion with the elegance of an eagle, symbolizing trust and leadership.

The visual identity balances bold symbolism with a refined, sophisticated aesthetic.

title: Posters Bundle #1
description: A poster design centered on typography, emphasizing visual hierarchy, balance, and expressive type as the primary design element.

title: Art Exhibition
description:
I collaborated with my friend, the artist Caiman, to create a cohesive visual identity for his first art exhibition.

The project included personal and exhibition logos, brochure-maps, promotional posters, social media content, and animated visuals.

I also created a looping video using elements from his paintings and helped plan the exhibition space, bringing the visual identity and physical experience together.

title: Drømmenes Melodi
description:
Drømmenes Melodi is an album identity created in collaboration with a musician for my final graphic design exam.

With no external imagery allowed, I built a dreamlike visual world through photo manipulation and digital illustration, reflecting the album's blend of rap and pop.

The identity brings together album artwork, Spotify assets, social media content, merchandise, and an animated logo into one cohesive visual universe.

title: Echo Festival
description:
This personal project explores a bold, modern visual identity for a fictional music and arts festival.

The design combines a vibrant blue palette with a dynamic logo and distinctive glass effects, capturing the energy and creativity of the festival.

The identity extends across posters, artist announcements, merchandise, social media, and stage visuals, creating a cohesive festival experience.

title: Breen Bygg & Service
description:
Breens Bygg & Service is a construction brand with a modern, timeless visual identity built around simplicity and professionalism.

Using the initials BBS, I created a cube-inspired symbol that reflects building blocks without relying on traditional construction imagery.

The result is a clean, versatile identity that communicates reliability and confidence across different applications.

title: i-D Magazine
description:
This school project explored editorial design through the unconventional visual style of graphic designer Cipe Pineles.

Inspired by her playful compositions and unexpected layouts, I experimented with typography, alignment, and structure to challenge traditional magazine design.

The result is a visually expressive publication that balances creative freedom with readability and intentional design.

title: Maltesers Package
description:
This school project explored maximalist packaging design through a bold redesign of Maltesers, inspired by the energetic artwork of Keith Haring.

Working within a fixed layout, I combined playful illustrations with small window cutouts that reveal the product inside.

The concept also includes a purple limited edition for white chocolate Maltesers, balancing expressive design with practical packaging requirements.
